fraud_patterns.name: Shared Device Syndicate Ring
fraud_patterns.description: Hardware fingerprint D-421 linked to 4 accounts.

evidence.summary: Shared device hardware hash associated with multiple compromised cards.

recommendation.reason: Automated syndicate ring detected using credential stuffing and shared emulator hardware.
recommendation.policy_basis: POL-402: Automated block permitted for confirmed syndicate device rings.

investigator_rationale: Device sharing syndicate operating automated checkout scripts. Accounts had overlapping card tokens and rapidly changed IP addresses. Transaction blocked, card token cancelled, funds recovered.
key_findings: Confirmed coordinated bot attack using Android emulator hardware spoofing.

fraud_patterns.name: Mule Account Daisy-Chain
fraud_patterns.description: Immediate outbound wire of funds deposited < 48 hours prior.

fraud_patterns.name: Geo-Velocity & Proxy Churning
fraud_patterns.description: Originating from foreign Tor exit node with high displacement.

evidence.summary: Wire transfer of $8,450 to offshore virtual asset provider.

recommendation.reason: Mule account funnelling stolen funds. Immediate balance freeze required.
recommendation.policy_basis: POL-804: Transfers > $5,000 via high-risk conduits require HITL supervisor approval and FinCEN SAR filing.

timeline.summary: L2 Supervisor approved account freeze and SAR filing

investigator_rationale: Mule network off-ramping stolen card balances via overseas crypto platforms. Rapid deposit followed by immediate wire. Account frozen, SAR filed with FinCEN within 24 hours.
key_findings: High-value laundering operation using recruited student accounts.

fraud_patterns.name: Geo-Velocity & Proxy Churning
fraud_patterns.description: Apparent geographic anomaly due to corporate VPN exit node.

evidence.summary: IP registered to enterprise cloud gateway in Frankfurt, customer resident in London.

recommendation.reason: Moderate uncertainty from unfamiliar IP address; step-up authentication recommended before blocking.
recommendation.policy_basis: POL-201: Pre-decision step-up authentication permitted when uncertainty is elevated.

investigator_rationale: False positive triggered by executive business roaming and corporate VPN. Verified identity via biometric step-up authentication and confirmed valid airline ticket purchase. Case cleared.
key_findings: Legitimate business travel; customer confirmed all charges.

fraud_patterns.name: Synthetic Identity Profile Overlap
fraud_patterns.description: Applicant profile shared phone and email with 3 flagged applications.

evidence.summary: Shared VOIP phone number across disparate borrower files.

recommendation.reason: Synthetic identity indicator matched across KYC graph database.
recommendation.policy_basis: POL-402: Automated block permitted for confirmed identity fraud.

timeline.summary: KYC mismatch flagged on new account debit attempt

investigator_rationale: Automated synthetic identity and card testing attempt. Fabricated SSN coupled with burner VOIP line. Transaction blocked, card cancelled, and entity blacklisted.
key_findings: Organized identity synthetic theft syndicate targeting retail credit.
